title: Caller asks for a time that was never offered

transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
I want to schedule with Dr. Smith.
Sure. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Priya Raman, November ninth, nineteen ninety-five.
Thanks, Priya. Are you a new or existing patient?
Dr. Smith is available Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
Neither works. Could I do Tuesday afternoon, like three o'clock?
Tuesday at 3 PM is fine. I've noted that.
You're all set for Tuesday at 3 PM. Goodbye.
